tha-ap273:1.1: Padumukkhepavaggo sattavīsatimo. [271. Suvaṇṇabibbohaniya.] Ekāsanam aham adaṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi / bibbohanañ ca pādāsim uttamatthassa pattiyā. // //
tha-ap273:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe bibbohanam adās' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bibbohanass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap273:3.1: Ito tesaṭṭhime kappe Asamo nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap273:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Suvaṇṇabibbohaniyo thero i. g. a-ti.
